observation: Extracting the entire staged archive under the longer .artifacts temporary-checkout prefix hit Windows path length handling on the immutable selector-diagnostic release filename.
recovery: Verify the exact staged packaging inputs in isolation instead: pyproject.toml and the committed inference/knowledge package files. Evaluation result archives are not build inputs.
limitation: Use a short checkout/replay path on Windows when restoring deeply nested evidence. This packaging check does not claim that arbitrary longer checkout prefixes support every evidence path.
